fixture_origin: recorded from the live API on 2026-10-13 by tests/studio/fixtures/record_fixtures.py: a DuckDB query (below) of the Overture release files over HTTPS; the same rows are in places_sample_cc0.parquet (body = the rows as JSON, for reading)

params.query: SELECT bbox, {'primary': taxonomy.primary, 'hierarchy': taxonomy.hierarchy} AS taxonomy, confidence, operating_status, list_transform(sources, s -> {'dataset': s.dataset, 'license': s.license}) AS sources FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE bbox.xmin BETWEEN ? AND ? AND bbox.ymin BETWEEN ? AND ? AND sources[1].license = 'CC0-1.0' ORDER BY bbox.ymin, bbox.xmin, taxonomy.primary LIMIT ?

license_note: every kept row's first source is licensed CC0-1.0 (AllThePlaces), per the row itself; the rows' later source entries are Overture contributions licensed CDLA-Permissive-2.0, so the CDLA Permissive 2.0 text (downloaded from cdla_text_url) is kept next to this file, as its section 2.1 asks
